description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.
The world's best AI personal assistant for email. Open source app to help you reach inbox zero fast.

🔥 PlainApp is an open-source app that lets you securely manage your phone from a web browser. Access files, media, contacts, SMS, calls, and more through a simple, easy-to-use interface on your desktop.

Snow Shot is free, open-source screenshot software and a screen recording tool for Windows and macOS, with annotation, scrolling screenshots, offline OCR and image pinning. 免费开源截图软件，支持截图标注、滚动长截图、离线 OCR、贴图与录屏。
An open-source, cross OS, community-driven launcher. A lightweight alternative to Spotlight and Raycast. Made with ❤️ from Viet Nam 🇻🇳
Bloop is a build server and CLI tool to compile, test and run Scala fast from any editor or build tool.
Ever® Teams™ - The Workplace for Humans. Open Work & Productivity Platform - https://ever.team

iPad-first, open-source iOS AI Agent with native on-device 3D/CAD editing, iPhone support and Android alpha. On-device Linux, terminal, Python/Node.js, Git and web previews; BYOK AI, Notes, Office, Canvas, voice, Skill Hub and supported local models on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 智能体工作台。
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
Local-first task manager with a visual weekly timeline. Works offline, syncs across devices, and self-hosts with one Docker command. Uses SQLite by default, so no external database is needed.

Open-source Arc-style browser built on Chromium: sidebar with vertical tabs, Spaces, folders, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click import from Arc. macOS and Windows (Linux is coming soon). No telemetry.
Forsion is All You Need. A local-first second-brain workbench: your files on one desk, and AI working on it with you.

Karui (軽い) is a offline only aesthetically pleasing, sync supported google tasks alternative to do list app, inspired by system-24 theme and windows mobile design system. It's a 145kb apk that allows you to take notes from status bar and from other apps with support for homescreen widgets! Made with ❤️ and Vue

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.
